warnings.message: sandbox.fail_if_unavailable is not true: where the sandbox cannot start, commands run unsandboxed, and deny_read and forbid write reach Claude's file tools and the file commands it recognizes in Bash (cat, head, sed, tee, redirections), not a script that opens files itself (allowed here: ["pnpm"])
Claude Code's file tools can read ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml: a mask covers sandboxed commands only (a deny_read entry would deny the sandbox too); on macOS a masked file is blocked instead of masked
